From the manufacturer

Logitech G502 Proteus Spectrum RGB Tuneable Gaming Mouse

Your favourite high-performance gaming mouse delivers more than ever.

G502 features our most advanced optical sensor for maximum tracking accuracy. Customize RGB lighting or sync it with other Logitech G products, set up custom profiles for your games, adjust sensitivity from 200 up to 12,000 DPI* and position five 3.6 g weights for just the right balance and feel. No matter your gaming style, it’s easy to tweak Proteus Spectrum to match you.

Highlights

  • tuneable weight and balance
  • RGB customizable lighting
  • Advanced Optical Sensor for precision targeting and manoeuvres
  • Comfortable shape for long gaming sessions
  • Enhanced customization with free Logitech Gaming Software
  • 11 programmable buttons
  • Five DPI settings with fast on-the-fly switching

Tunable weight and balance

Personal tweaks make all the difference. Position a few or all five of the 3.6 g weights for a mouse that feels just right for you.

RGB customizable lighting

Match your style and environment by adjusting up to 16.8 million colours and brightness.Bring your mouse to life with breathing light patterns or set your lighting to sleep when you aren’t using your system. Some profile settings require Logitech Gaming Software, available at the official website.

Accurate, responsive optical sensor

Get maxeimum tracking accuracy from our most responsive optical sensor (PMW3366). Exclusive Logitech-G Delta Zero optical sensor technology minimises mouse acceleration and increases reliable targeting.

Easy-to-programmeme Logitech Gaming Software

Sync colours and light patterns with other Logitech-G RGB gaming products. Tune the sensor to match the surface for maxeimum speed and lower lift-off. Programmeme buttonnes with custom macros. And manage lighting, DPI sensitivity, and buttonne profiles.

Comfortable design for extended gaming

Textured rubber grips and a convenient buttonne layout give Proteus Spectrum RGB an overall great feel and stellar performance from day one.

Customizable control

Easily customise 11 programmememable buttonnes on G502 Proteus Spectrum for your favourite games. Adjust hyper-fast scrolling to just your speed. And switch DPI modes on the fly -- choose from five settings from 200 to 12,000 DPI.

Compatibility

System requirements

  • Windows 10, Windows 8.1, Windows 8 or Windows 7
  • USB port
  • Internet connexion for optional software download

What’s in the box:

- Mouse

- Tuning weights and case.

- User Documentation

      5.0 out of 5 stars Great to use and accessible for those who have hand pain
      Reviewed in Canada on 22 November 2025
      Verified Purchase
      Out of all the mice I've used, this is hands-down my favourite one. The programmable buttons are super clicky in a satisfying way. It’s also great being able to map the buttons to whatever I need, which makes things a lot more convenient day to day. It's helped me with both games and work and you can have the mapped buttons saved to different apps as well.

      I also really like how there's 2 different scroll wheels modes—one clicky and controlled, the other buttery smooth. Ever since I injured myself, I switch between them depending on what I’m doing. The smooth scroll has definitely helped ease the pain when scrolling and makes this mouse more accessible than most I've used.

      The mouse has adjustable weights as well if you like it to be heavier or lighter. I don't find much of a difference with the weight but it's a nice option to have for those who do.
